verdict.rationale: Cline's first-party CLI scheduling docs describe running agents on cron schedules through the hub. These scheduled agents persist across process restarts, run independently of any terminal session, and handle recurring automations such as daily summaries and code reviews. The GitHub README separately mentions scheduling routines in the native app. This is a true recurring schedule, not just a one-off headless run. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled jobs work as documented, and deeper detail on schedule management (listing, editing, failure handling).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: The CLI supports running agents on cron schedules through the hub. Scheduled agents persist across process restarts and run independently of any terminal session.
